title: Write a headline in title case
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Read one line of words separated by single spaces. Print it with the first letter of every word in upper case and the rest of the word in lower case, except the small words `a`, `an`, `the`, `of`, `and`, `in`, `on`, `to`, which stay in lower case unless they are the first word. Characters that are not letters stay as they are.
